attchmntText: Gufic Biosciences Limited has informed the Exchange about Newspaper advertisement of Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Mini Diamonds India reported consolidated revenue of 41,071.41 lakhs and profit after tax of 560.56 lakhs for the half year ended September 30, 2026. This represents a 64.26% increase in revenue and a 27.37% rise in profit compared to the previous year. The Board approved these results on November 14, 2026. Gufic Biosciences announced the publication of its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, in newspapers on November 16, 2026. Nibe Limited stated that its Board approved the unaudited financial results for the same period on November 14, 2026. Valson Industries Limited filed its statement of unaudited results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Gufic Biosciences Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Gufic Biosciences Limited filed an investor presentation regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The presentation highlights progress at the Indore manufacturing facility, which commenced commercial production in October 2024. The site is registered with the US FDA, and a pre-approval inspection was completed with three observations currently being addressed. The facility has an installed capacity of 50 million lyophilized vials, 30 million liquid vials, and 72 million ampoules per year. The company reported that EU audit compliance reports were submitted with certification awaited. Business updates include the launch of AWABAC, expansion of the hospital injectable platform, and new orders in the Gulf and Latin America. The presentation includes standard safe harbor and forward-looking statement disclaimers.

attchmntText: Gufic Biosciences Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Director(s) of the company.
voiceSummary: Gufic Biosciences Limited has appointed Dr. Reeta Shah, DIN 07141304, as an Additional Director and Non-Executive Independent Director. The appointment was approved by the Board of Directors on November 14, 2026. The term is for 5 consecutive years, effective from December 01, 2026. This appointment is subject to shareholder approval. Dr. Reeta Shah is a Chartered Accountant with a Ph.D. in Finance from IIT Bombay. She has over 38 years of experience in Finance, Education, and Administration. She is not debarred by SEBI or any other authority. She is not related to any Director of the Company. The Board meeting commenced at 5:00 p.m. and concluded at 06:35 p.m.

attchmntText: Gufic Biosciences Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Gufic Biosciences Limited approved unaudited financial results for the half-year ended September 30, 2026. Standalone net profit was 4,594.91 lakhs, compared to 2,701.04 lakhs in the previous year. Consolidated net profit stood at 4,578.14 lakhs. Revenue from operations for the half-year was 54,921.95 lakhs standalone and 54,909.10 lakhs consolidated. The Board also appointed Dr. Reeta Shah, DIN 07141304, as an Additional Director, Non-Executive Independent Director, effective December 01, 2026, for a five-year term. This appointment is subject to shareholder approval.

attchmntText: Gufic Biosciences Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation of Environmental, Social and Governance ( ESG ) Rating
voiceSummary: Gufic Biosciences Limited has intimated that SES ESG Research Private Limited, a SEBI Registered Category II Environmental, Social and Governance Ratings Provider, has assigned an overall ESG rating of 69.7 out of 100, categorized as Medium, for the financial year 2025-26. The rating report is dated November 12, 2026, and was received by the company on the same date. The company clarifies that it did not engage SES for this ESG rating. SES independently assigned the rating based on information available in the public domain. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30(6) read with Part A of Schedule III of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015, and SEBI Master Circular dated January 30, 2026. The notice was issued on November 13, 2026, to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited.
